head: ChatGPT GPT-6.2: new Astra and Sol models for Plus and Pro users
dek: OpenAI released GPT-6.2 Astra and GPT-6.2 Sol in ChatGPT and Codex on 17 November for Plus, Pro, Enterprise and Edu users. Astra is meant for hard, long projects, Sol for everyday writing and coding.
details: OpenAI says both models finish demanding tasks with fewer output tokens, so you can do more before reaching your plan's usage limit. Astra can take a screenshot of a slide and copy its layout, colours and font sizes. Pro subscribers at 200 dollars a month get the faster Ultrafast mode with Sol, and the 500-dollar Pro plan gets it on both models; Ultrafast answers up to 4.5 times faster but uses more of your allowance. The sources don't mention the free plan or Go.
where: ChatGPT Plus, Pro, Enterprise and Edu, and Codex, from 17 November 2026
means: If you pay for ChatGPT Plus or Pro, two new models are in your model menu, and longer tasks may use less of your limit than before.
todo: Open ChatGPT's model picker and try Sol for everyday questions; switch to Astra for long documents, slides or bigger projects.
thumb_words: CHATGPT GETS GPT-6.2 ASTRA AND SOL
